memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: There has never been a day like it before or since, a day when the Lord listened to a human being. Surely the Lord was fighting for Israel! — Josh 10:14 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This verse pauses to marvel at what just happened: "There has never been a day like it." But look closely at what makes the day so remarkable. It is not merely that the sun stood still. The wonder Scripture points to is this: "a day when the Lord listened to a human being." The astonishing thing was that the Almighty God bent His ear to the voice of one man and acted on his request.

Think about that. The God who commands the sun and moon paid attention to Joshua's prayer. The Creator of the universe listened to a mere man and answered. That is a staggering truth. God is not distant and indifferent; He hears the prayers of His people and He responds. The greatest miracle here may not be the stationary sun, but the listening God.

Then comes the heart of it all: "Surely the Lord was fighting for Israel!" This is the true explanation for everything that happened that day. Not Joshua's strategy, not Israel's swords, not even the lengthened day in itself, but this: God was fighting for His people. The whole account exists to declare this one glorious fact.

What a comfort for every believer. The same God who listened to Joshua listens to us. Through Christ, we have access to the Father who hears our prayers (1 John 5:14-15). And the same God who fought for Israel fights for us. We do not face our battles alone or unheard. The Lord bends His ear to His children and works on their behalf. Surely the Lord fights for His people still.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you truly believe God listens when you pray?
2. How does it change your battles to know the Lord Himself is fighting for you?
3. Does the wonder of a God who hears draw you to pray more freely?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, what a wonder that You, the Creator of all things, listen to my prayers. Thank You that You fight for Your people. Help me pray, trusting that You truly hear. Amen.
